name: label
useFor: Name every field with a Label tied to it by htmlFor, 4px above the field. For a label with a hint or an action beside it (Forgot password?), use Field. Mark a required field with * inside the label (it turns red) and required on the control.
constraints: A label in the action purple
source: Figma 427:2715: Login (Email address, Password), Vault (Vault key)
title: Label
description: A field's 14px regular ink label on a 24px line, with a red required mark.
